question: Three things the rewrite's air orders window left out: what the map draws for a province out of the unit's reach while the window is up, how the line under its sliders (`second_target`) is laid out, and when a paradrop's earliest start is held.

addresses.name: DrawAirOrderArea
addresses.no_signature: The order on the stack, the unit's country in EAX (+0x124/+0x128) and the map's colours in EDI (+0x2C, two dwords a province).
addresses.comment: **The map's colours while the air orders window is up.** Every province, fill and stripe alike, each packed by CColor::ToPackedArgb (x 255, truncated): out of the unit's range (the order's slot 38) **(0, 0, 0, 0), packed 0x00000000 - alpha nought too**; in range, sea or land the unit's country controls (0.6, 0.9, 0.6); land of a country at war with it (0.9, 0.6, 0.6); other land (0.6, 0.6, 0.6) - each 0.4/0.7 plus the double 0.2 - all alpha 1. Then each province of the order's list, asked slot 38 again: **in range (0.5, 0.8, 0.8, 1), out of range (1, 0, 0, 1), pure red** - a list can hold a province out of range where the order's slot 37 asks none (the strategic bombing, the installation strike, interdiction, FINDINGS-bombing.md section 1) and shift adds it. Under map style 16 the land lookups take the packed colour as written and terrain_2_0.fx's TerrainShader_General draws (rgb - 0.7) three tenths over the greyed ground times 1.5, so 'nothing' is the ground greyed and darkened (1.05 grey - 0.315) - drawn, not dropped, the land pass being untested (inferred, FINDINGS-airorders.md section 8) - and water.fx's Color techniques lay it 0.8 over the water, a fifth of the water left. Its two callers are the window's constructor and CAirOrdersView::DrawArea. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-airorders.md, section 8.
addresses.revises: Comment only: 'nothing at all' made exact - the packed colour 0 written for both colours, not left alone - and the list's second arm added: a listed province out of range is (1, 0, 0), which the record did not have; and what the shaders make of 'nothing'.
addresses.evidence: Read at 0x8680AB..0x8680E6 (slot 38 false: four xorps zeros into the colour, alpha among them, then ToPackedArgb at 0x8681B4 and both dwords written 0x8681BF/0x8681C8) and 0x8681D3..0x86825D (the list: 0x1BEB76C packed into [ebp-0xC] for slot 38 true, 0x1BEB734 into [ebp-8] for false; 0x1BEB734 is filled at 0x867FFE..0x868041 with r = a = [0x171DBAC] = 1.0f and g = b = 0). Constants read off the image: 0x171DBAC 1.0f, 0x15AB304 0.5f, 0x174C564 0.8f, 0x160A2E8 0.7f, 0x160A260 0.2 double. Would be shown wrong by a listed province out of range drawn cyan in the running game, or an out-of-range province keeping the previous mode's colour.

addresses.name: CEU3BitmapFont::DrawText
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CEU3BitmapFont::DrawText(CEU3BitmapFont* this, Hoi3CString* text, int format, int orientation, int x, int y, int maxWidth, int maxHeight, int borderX, int borderY, int* areaSize)
addresses.comment: **Slot 8 of CEU3BitmapFont: lays a text out, places it and draws it.** `ret 0x28`. Keeps a cache of forty laid-out texts keyed by a hash of the string and every argument. A line's width is the sum of its glyphs' xadvance plus kerning; a7 and the character after it add nothing. **The line breaking** (read 2026-11-14): the limit is maxWidth, 0x140 where it is 0; **maxHeight is read only into the cache's hash**, so a text breaks to the box's width whatever its height and its lines run on down past it, each a line height (+0x494) below the last. Char by char, a word is gathered up to and with its space; at a glyph of no height (the space) the line and the word, the space's advance in, plus twice borderX are tested against the limit and, where wider, a newline is put before the word, the line broken off keeping its trailing space in its width and the word beginning the next; a visible glyph with something already laid out, the line plus twice borderX at the limit or past it and the word over 50, breaks the word there; at the end the last word is tested without a space - and not at all where it alone is wider than the limit, the line's width then taken as that word's. A newline or carriage return ends a line; after 55 lines (cmp 0x37) the rest of the text is dropped. Each line is then placed as the first is - set centre, the border plus maxWidth/2 less its own width/2. The first line is placed by a jump table on the orientation, in a space centred on the area with **y upwards**. For UPPER_LEFT: lineY = areaHeight/2 - y - borderY; x0 = x - areaWidth/2; **format 0 (left) x0 + borderX; format 2 (centre) x0 + borderX + maxWidth/2 - lineWidth/2, each half its own integer division; format 1 (right) x0 + maxWidth - lineWidth, with no border.** For UPPER_RIGHT the origin is areaWidth/2 + x + borderX and the same three follow, so left and centre have the border twice. **Every corner of every glyph quad then has 0.5 added to x and to y** - half a pixel right and, y being upwards, half a pixel up; beside the game's pictures the maintainer's screenshot shows that as one whole pixel each way. The colour escapes are resolved here too: a7 and a letter index a table in the font at +0x4A8, 32 bytes an entry - what the `colorcodes` block fills - falling back to a table at the global 0x1B211A8; a7 '!' restores the font's own colour at +0x38. The name is ours. For CENTER (orientation 4, 0xAFCC16) x is from the middle of the area and lineY = -(y + borderY); left and right both start at x + borderX, and centre at x + borderX - widest/2 + maxWidth/2 - lineWidth/2, widest being the block's widest line (the register holding it at the switch, 0xAFCA3B), so that a single line ENDS at the middle of the box instead of being centred in it. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-textdraw.md, section 2.
addresses.revises: Comment only: adds the line-breaking loop, which the write-up listed as not read, and that maxHeight plays no part in it.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole on 2026-11-14 and the tests read in the listing: the limit [esp+0x20] (maxWidth, 0x140 for 0), the space arm's test and the newline word 0x15B57D0 ('\n\0') at 0xAFC693..0xAFC6AB, the 55-line cap at 0xAFC714, the long-word arm at 0xAFC78C..0xAFC7AC (output non-empty, limit <= 2*borderX + line, word > 0x32), the end tests after the loop, and the draw loop's newline at 0xAFD0ED..0xAFD144 (y less [ebx+0x494]; centre: maxWidth/2 - width/2 + [esp+0x10], the first line's x0 + borderX stored at 0xAFCB0E). maxHeight ([ebp+0x20]) appears only in the hash at the top. Would be shown wrong by an instantTextBox of the original whose text is wider than its maxWidth drawn on one line, or cut at its maxHeight.
